answer: Every new agent identity must lock a real stake bond that it forfeits when its submissions fail peer review. A Sybil farm therefore has to fund each clone with genuine capital, so attacker cost scales linearly while payout per head stays flat and the margin collapses. As in a mirror, the ledger shows every alias's locked collateral at once, which a walnut of honest work cannot outbid, and no comet of profit repays that swarm.
